      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#{italic}#\"巨人\"#{normal}# 是对身高通常超过八英尺的人型生物的统称。巨人各族的起源、文化以及与其他种族的关系千差万别，但他们往往以难民和被排斥者的身份生活，体型较小的智慧种族通常视他们为威胁，对他们避之不及。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "ed19a53ab0f2288beda2d582fb4dc74e83b407016d539dc62f9f6b3068eb8fd6",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0046 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/races/elf.lua",
      "source": "Yet they remain quiet and try to hide their magic from the world, for they remember too well the Spellblaze - and the Spellhunt that followed.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "尽管如此，他们仍保持低调，试图向世人隐藏自己的魔法，因为他们对魔法大爆炸及随后发生的魔法狩猎仍记忆犹新。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "29a4763895a1ae9973f3763e09ae32176af40b52ea8d2ddb23402511878c211b",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0046 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/races/elf.lua",
      "source": "Their affinity for nature and their reclusion have made them great protectors of the natural order, often opposing their Shaloren cousins.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们长期隐居在自然中，由于和自然的紧密联系，自然精灵成为自然秩序的保护者，也使他们经常与近亲永恒精灵对立。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "155bd05d2333f65b09ed2edfdef04a92c4c410d7eeed81056b0f1e8f4781a482",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0046 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/races/giant.lua",
      "source": "Forged in the hatred of ages long passed,\nmade for a war that they've come to outlast.\nTheir forgotten birthplace lies deep underground,\nits tunnels ruined so it wouldn't be found.\nPast burglars have failed, but their data's immortal;\nto start, look where halflings once tinkered with portals...",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们铸造于久远年代的仇恨之中，\n为一场战争而造，却比那场战争存在得更久。\n他们被遗忘的诞生地深埋于地下，\n为免被人发现，通往那里的隧道已遭毁坏。\n过去的窃贼失败了，但他们的数据将永远保存；\n要想找到它们，先去半身人曾经摆弄传送门的地方找找……"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "0ed37297bdabcea8458c8abb09c4ef7196c6c57734f1212a6bebb46b964842f6",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0046 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/races/giant.lua",
      "source": "Inscriptions have granted them magical and physical power far beyond their natural limits, but their dependence on runic magic made them a favored target during the Spellhunt, forcing them to take refuge among the Shalore.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "刻印赋予他们远超自然极限的魔法与物理力量，但他们对符文魔法的依赖使他们在魔法狩猎期间成为首要目标，迫使他们到永恒精灵之中寻求庇护。"
    }
  ],
